description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, a Fragment subclass that contains a LogView and manages its display within a ScrollView. It handles view creation, layout setup, and updates to the log display.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that displays a log view within a scrollable layout, handling view inflation and text change events.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styles, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the views, sets up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on text changes, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance contained in the fragment.
